attchmntText: Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: HMT Limited published its Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on November 08, 2026. The company published newspaper advertisements in Financial Express, Hosadigantha, and Rajasthan Patrika on November 08, 2026. The financial results are available on the company website at https://www.hmtindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/As-on-30-09-2026.pdf. The disclosure complies with Regulation 33 read with Regulation 47(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The Chairman and Managing Director, N. Ramesh Kumar, signed the statement on November 06, 2026. The company's CIN is L29230KA1953G01000748.
